method_archive.note: Curated compare_plan2 runs of R, H, RB, RCUT and RCUT2 on Case33 (18,25) and (18,25,30), 300 s wall clock. Per run: summary.json, metrics.json (all checkpoints, AC primary / SOCP diagnostic), timeline.csv, gzip solves.csv and final snapshot. Intermediate checkpoint snapshots and partition logs stay in the local results/compare_plan2; metrics.json is authoritative and is not recomputed from this archive. RCUT inner sets are not certified (inner_exact false): its validity checks the outer bound only.
